nodes.name: .htaccess
nodes.summary: Apache config: rewrites .php-less pretty URLs to the underlying .php file, blocks direct access to .search_cache.json, and auto-prepends mobile-prepend.php into every response so mobile.css/mobile.js load on all pages.

nodes.name: .user.ini
nodes.summary: Per-directory PHP runtime override that sets auto_prepend_file to mobile-prepend.php as a fallback for servers that do not honor the .htaccess php_value directive.

nodes.name: art.txt
nodes.summary: One-line scratch note holding a single external URL (an SBMA Underhill-AI event page) with no other content.

nodes.name: asanai_blog_proxy.php
nodes.summary: Self-contained reverse proxy that fetches any path under asanai.scads.ai/blog over cURL, validates the target to block SSRF, and rewrites relative src/href and in-JS asset paths so proxied HTML/JS keeps loading through the proxy.
nodes.languageNotes: Procedural PHP; uses cURL with FOLLOWLOCATION, a MIME map keyed on file extension, and preg_replace_callback to redirect asset references through itself.

nodes.name: attention_engine.js
nodes.summary: Large interactive multi-head self-attention engine for the Transformer lesson: runs a real QKV forward pass over tokens, renders per-head attention-weight matrices with LaTeX annotations, an 'attention path visualizer' (APV) arc view, and hooks for provenance/TDA tooling.
nodes.languageNotes: Single AttentionEngine class with a static hook registry (onForward/_fireForwardHooks) so external tooling can observe every forward pass; registers instances into window.__apv_instances and drives rendering through layered tab builders.

nodes.name: AttentionEngine
nodes.summary: The attention computation + rendering engine: holds QKV/output weights, runs the causal multi-head forward pass, and renders per-head weight matrices and context vectors into the lesson's DOM.

nodes.name: forward
nodes.summary: Runs one attention forward pass: projects h0 into Q/K/V, slices per-head, scores (with causal mask), softmaxes, and computes per-token context vectors, then fires registered forward hooks.

nodes.name: renderUI
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the on-screen attention visualization, dispatching to unified layer tabs or the fallback tab builder and updating per-layer content as head data changes.

nodes.name: onForward
nodes.summary: Static public hook: registers a callback invoked after every forward pass with the engine, head data, hidden state, tokens and token strings, letting TDA/provenance tooling subscribe without touching rendering.

nodes.name: dot
nodes.summary: Matrix multiplication used for the QKV/output projections, with defensive shape checks that return empty results on malformed input.

nodes.name: softmax
nodes.summary: Numerically-aware softmax that normalizes the attention scores of a row into weights summing to 1.

nodes.name: bildquellen-pruefung.txt
nodes.summary: Image source-and-license audit log: per-image records (URL, license via the Commons API, author, local filename, lesson of use, and OK/UNCLEAR status) documenting provenance and licensing for every figure in the book.

nodes.name: bpe.js
nodes.summary: Self-contained Byte-Pair-Encoding tokenizer: trains a merge table on a text corpus and tokenizes by replaying merges with a greedy longest-match fallback for rare words.
nodes.languageNotes: Single BPETokenizer class; training only uses non-whitespace words and preserves whitespace runs as their own tokens at tokenize-time.

nodes.name: BPETokenizer
nodes.summary: BPE subword tokenizer holding a character vocabulary and an ordered merge list; exposes train() to build the merge table and tokenize() to segment text into subword tokens.

nodes.name: train
nodes.summary: Iteratively finds the most frequent adjacent token pair above a frequency floor, merges it, and records it, building the ordered merge list until no pairs qualify or a maxMerges cap is hit.

nodes.name: tokenize
nodes.summary: Segments text into words and whitespace runs, replays the learned merges per word, and falls back to greedy longest-match against the known token set so rare words avoid single-character splits.

nodes.name: category_theory.html
nodes.summary: Standalone test page that renders a TikZJax commutative diagram (x -> f(x) -> (g o f)(x)) to verify the diagram toolchain used for category-theory content.

nodes.name: citation_graph.js
nodes.summary: Data file exposing window.citationGraph, a directed map from each literature.js citation key to the keys it builds on, encoding the intellectual lineage (foundations through modern LLMs) behind the book's bibliography.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure data: assigns one window.citationGraph object literal of key -> [ancestor keys]; grouped by era via comment headers.

nodes.name: cluster.js
nodes.summary: Implements 'Aurora Clusters': converts [[c:name]]...[[/c]] markers in lesson Markdown into softly-glowing color lanes, assigning each cluster name a stable hue (curated palette or golden-angle fallback) and injecting matching CSS variables.
nodes.languageNotes: IIFE exposing window.BlogClusters; registers a custom marked block extension so multi-paragraph cluster blocks get correct inner wrapping, and a MutationObserver re-injects CSS vars for late-loading modules.

nodes.name: preprocess
nodes.summary: Runs before marked.parse: registers the clusterBlock marked extension (once) and delegates to the balanced scanner to turn inline clusters into data-cluster spans.

nodes.name: findNextCluster
nodes.summary: Balanced scanner that walks the text to the next [[c:NAME]]/[[cluster:NAME]] open, then advances char-by-char matching nested opens to their closes and returns the name, inner text and span.

nodes.name: injectCSS
nodes.summary: Scans the DOM (and window.__blogClusters) for cluster names and writes a #blog-cluster-vars <style> block defining --cl-<name> base/glow/soft/mist/halo custom properties, skipping rework when the name set is unchanged.

nodes.name: getColor
nodes.summary: Resolves a cluster name to its hue (from the curated PALETTE or a deterministic golden-angle hash) and derives the full HSL palette (base, glow, soft, mist, three halos).

nodes.name: commutation.html
nodes.summary: A pre-rendered SVG of the same commutative diagram (x, f(x), (g o f)(x) with f, g o f, g arrows) used as a static asset alongside the TikZJax test page.

nodes.name: Corrections for coherent_world_models.php
nodes.summary: Content-audit of the coherent_world_models lesson cataloguing 9 mathematical/philosophical inconsistencies (object-vs-element G, fan-vs-chain cover structure, self-undermining 'coherence = descent', etc.) with a severity table; all items marked as applied.

nodes.name: darkmode_todo.txt
nodes.summary: Tracking note of dark-mode background fixes per lesson (white Plotly/ECharts canvases and light callout boxes), each marked FIXED, plus maintenance notes pointing to the CSS block and the global Plotly theme observer in helper.js.

nodes.name: effects.js
nodes.summary: Quiet visual enhancement: adds an 'effects-on' class to <html> and cascade-fades in each .course-part via IntersectionObserver as it scrolls into view, falling back to fully visible when the observer or reduced-motion is unavailable.
nodes.languageNotes: IIFE; respects prefers-reduced-motion and no-JS (default visible state).

nodes.name: fcnn_visualization.js
nodes.summary: Canvas renderer for a full-network (Dense/Flatten/LayerNorm/Conv2D) architecture: reads the live TF.js model's layers, computes node/layer layout, and draws connected neurons with theme-aware colors and labels.
nodes.languageNotes: Global functions driven by a shared `model` (TF.js) handle; debounced restart via setTimeout, and uses themeColor()/isDarkMode() helpers for theming.

nodes.name: draw_fcnn
nodes.summary: Sizing and draw entry point: sizes the #fcnn_canvas from its container, computes node radius and layer spacing, and hands off to the low-level drawer.

nodes.name: restart_fcnn
nodes.summary: Debounced (100ms) redraw trigger that clears any pending timeout and re-renders the network once the canvas is visible.

nodes.name: get_fcnn_data
nodes.summary: Walks the TF.js model.layers, keeping only Dense/Flatten/LayerNorm/Conv2D layers, and returns parallel arrays of layer names, unit counts, and per-layer meta info for the drawer.

nodes.name: find_double_defined_js.sh
nodes.summary: Development shell script that greps every .js file for top-level 'function <name>' definitions and reports any name defined more than once in a file, exiting non-zero if duplicates are found.

nodes.name: functions.php
nodes.summary: The blog's central server-side infrastructure: parses every lesson's COURSE_METADATA block to auto-build the course drawer/index/progress, provides the asset and lesson loaders (js/css/incl), the post-load JS orchestrator, and renders the chrome (theme/topics/reader toggles, drawer, module nav, hero constellation).
nodes.languageNotes: Mix of PHP helpers and an inline <script> post-load orchestrator; scans *.php files via glob and parses COURSE_METADATA comments so lessons are discovered automatically. A mid-file output-buffering seam (the '}' at line ~694) closes the if(!index) HTML head/body block before the remaining helper functions are defined.

nodes.name: parse_course_metadata
nodes.summary: Core discovery routine: globs all *.php lessons, extracts each COURSE_METADATA comment, sorts by part then order, and returns modules grouped by part — the single source of truth for the drawer, index tiles and progress.

nodes.name: incl
nodes.summary: Includes a lesson section: loads its matching .js (passing the headline as the loader label), requires the .php file to exist, prints the <h1>, and includes the lesson body.

nodes.name: js
nodes.summary: De-duplicating script tag emitter: anchors local lookups to __DIR__, appends a ?v=filemtime cache buster, and for files defining load*Module() pushes the loader onto window.__moduleLoaderQueue with a cleaned label.

nodes.name: css
nodes.summary: Emits a stylesheet <link> with a ?v=filemtime cache buster for local files (or a raw link for URLs).

nodes.name: load_base_js
nodes.summary: Loads the full base asset bundle (Temml, bpe, echarts, prism, literature, citation_graph, jquery, plotly, tf, marked, helper, cluster, topics, search, keypoint, progress_tracker, and all modules/*.js) and prints the inline post-load coordination script.

nodes.name: print_font_override
nodes.summary: Prints a <head> font override: preloads the chosen serif (Lingua Franca or Computer Modern), publishes window.__blogFontSpecs for force-loading, and sets the --mn-font-* CSS variables site-wide.

nodes.name: render_gem_tabs
nodes.summary: Renders a CSS-only radio-button tab group (title => content panels) with a unique hash per group so multiple tab groups can coexist on one page, and injects a one-time copy-buttons script.

nodes.name: print_dynamic_title
nodes.summary: Reads the calling lesson's own COURSE_METADATA title and emits it into the requested tag (the <title> with LaTeX $ stripped, or the <h1>).

nodes.name: get_ai_course_labels
nodes.summary: Builds the \label{...} -> lesson-slug map by scanning every lesson's content, used to resolve in-page label targets for the course index.

nodes.name: render_course_tile
nodes.summary: Renders one course index tile as a link card with icon, title, description, accent color, and data-topics/data-tags/data-mathlevel attributes that drive the 3-state dimming in topics.js.

nodes.name: get_module_nav_data
nodes.summary: Flattens parse_course_metadata into the linear course order and returns it with the current lesson's index, powering the progress bar and next/prev navigation.

nodes.name: render_module_nav
nodes.summary: Renders the previous/next lesson navigation links for the current lesson based on get_module_nav_data.

nodes.name: render_drawer
nodes.summary: Renders the slide-out course drawer: a backdrop, a header with close button, and per-part sections listing every module, marking the current lesson active.

nodes.name: render_theme_toggle
nodes.summary: Renders the top-right dark/light toggle button (sun/moon SVGs) wired to toggleTheme().

nodes.name: render_topics_toggle
nodes.summary: Renders the 'pick your interests' target button that opens the topics overlay (wired up later by topics.js).

nodes.name: render_reader_toggle
nodes.summary: Renders the reader-mode book button (keyboard shortcut R) wired to toggleReaderMode(), a CSS-only focus mode persisted in localStorage.

nodes.name: render_constellation
nodes.summary: Emits the hero <canvas class="organic-network"> and loads organic-network.js to paint the drifting node/edge backdrop that self-fades on scroll.

nodes.name: runPostLoad
nodes.summary: Inline-JS orchestrator that runs exactly once after both modules and window load: extracts sidenotes, runs bibtexify + renderMarkdown, force-loads the page's font faces (4s capped), reveals content, and dispatches blogPostLoadComplete.

nodes.name: A Geometric and Topological Theory of Meaningful Language Spaces
nodes.summary: Long research-program essay proposing a geometric/topological account of language: a combinatorial possibility space X_N, multi-field 'void vectors' (syntactic/semantic/grounding/epistemic), cosmic-web cluster-filament-void structure, fractality, and a four-level program ending in open questions.

nodes.name: graph.php
nodes.summary: 'River of Ideas' interactive SVG timeline: a ~15-row-by-11-column vertical graph of ~120 AI-history milestones across 8 colored streams, with curved dependency edges, hover tooltips, 2-hop connectedness highlighting, a legend, era bands, and optional scroll-to-section highlighting.
nodes.languageNotes: Self-contained: inline <style> + <script> IIFE with hardcoded NODES and EDGES data arrays; draws glow + main path per edge, era bands and a right-side timeline, and re-renders on resize.
